question: Which of the following is referred to as ‘credit money’?

options.text: Money value = 10 percent less than Commodity value

solution:
The correct answer is __**Money Value > Commodity Value.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The commodity value of money is less than the monetary value of money, it is called Credit money.
 
• Credit money is monetary value created as the result of some future obligation or claim.
